brief.text: BORR generated the largest overall volume, leading the cluster tables at $32,057,658 across three insiders while also appearing among individual transactions with a $5,390,250 purchase by director Tor Olav Troim. DKS recorded the highest participant concentration, with seven separate insiders accounting for $5,588,663 in total value. Closed-end funds represented a common theme across both lists, encompassing multi-buyer activity in PSUS ($9,858,899) and BPRE ($13,021,674) alongside individual director and 10% owner trades in PHK, PDI, CET, GF, and GRX.
